(5) A liquid pouring sound effect is heard as the voice adopts a helpful but exaggeratedly polite tone. (12) The original pink character's voice returns, speaking in a high-pitched, defensive, and blushing tone. (13) A heavy thud SFX is heard as the voice sounds exhausted and defeated. (14) The voice speaks in a soft, apologetic, and slightly tearful tone. (15) A dramatic musical riser or sting accompanies a determined shout. (18) A deep, authoritative, and very stern male voice speaks slowly with clear articulation. (19) A high-pitched 'GIVE ME FIVE' shout is heard, followed by a digital clap or slap sound effect. (20) The raspy voice shouts again in a shocked and indignant manner. (21) A bouncy rhythmic sound effect accompanies the character walking, as the voice speaks in a singsong, rhyming pattern. (22) A loud, comedic wailing sound effect dominates the mix. (23) A rustling bag sound effect is heard as the voice sounds relieved and tired. (24) A friendly, high-pitched goodbye phrase is spoken. (25) The BGM swells for a final few seconds as a composite of various previous vocal snippets plays rapidly, concluding with a final energetic shout announcing the product launch.
